metas.name: Drishyam 3
metas.description: To protect his family and their dark secret, Georgekutty faces an organized new threat. As walls close in and cracks widen, how much more is he willing to sacrifice?

metas.name: Drishyam
metas.description: When his family stares down the barrel of criminal charges, a commoner channels his street smarts and knowledge of action films to tie the long arm of the law into an investigative Gordian knot.

metas.name: The Post
metas.description: A cover-up spanning four U.S. Presidents pushes the country's first female newspaper publisher and her editor to join an unprecedented battle between press and government.

metas.name: 365 dni
metas.description: Massimo is a member of the Sicilian Mafia family and Laura is a sales director. She does not expect that on a trip to Sicily trying to save her relationship, Massimo will kidnap her and give her 365 days to fall in love with him.

metas.name: How to Have Sex
metas.description: Three British teenage girls go on a rites-of-passage holiday - drinking, clubbing and hooking up, in what should be the best summer of their lives.

metas.name: Hari Hara Veera Mallu Part 1: Sword Vs Spirit
metas.description: The first Indian to orchestrate a revolt against the Mughal empire. The early life of Veera Mallu and the mission he chooses to raise revolution against the ghastly actions of the army generals in the Mughal empire.

metas.name: The Love Hypothesis
metas.description: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

metas.name: Jana Nayagan
metas.description: A clash of ideologies. One stands for the people, the other feeds on control. Their paths collided once before. Years later, a child’s silent fear ignites the past, drawing a former police officer into a battle far bigger than personal revenge.

metas.name: Mohabbatein
metas.description: A film about the battle between love and fear, between two stubborn men and their opposing beliefs and the outcome of the love stories of 3 couples.

metas.name: Nude
metas.description: NUDE explores perceptions of nudity in art by chronicling the creative process of photographer David Bellemere as he's commissioned by NU Muses founder Steve Shaw to shoot a fine art calendar of nude photographs.

metas.name: Hridayam
metas.description: The emotional journey of Arun, his carefree bachelor days in engineering college, and how he matures through various phases of life.

metas.name: Drishyam 2
metas.description: 7 years after the case related to Vijay Salgaonkar and his family was closed, a series of unexpected events bring truth to light that threatens to change everything for the Salgaonkars. Can Vijay save his family this time?

metas.name: Avengers: Endgame
metas.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.

metas.name: Officer on Duty
metas.description: A demoted police inspector investigates a counterfeit jewelry racket, becoming entangled in a dangerous web of crime that puts his life at stake.

metas.name: Jawaani Jaaneman
metas.description: The carefree life of a 40-year-old playboy comes to a standstill when he comes to know that he has a 20 something-year-old daughter.

metas.name: Tell Me What You Want
metas.description: After his father's death, Eric Zimmerman travels to Spain to oversee his company's branches. In Madrid, he falls for Judith and engage in an intense, erotic relationship full of exploration. However, Eric fears his secret may end their affair.

metas.name: Viduthalai Part 2
metas.description: An unassuming school teacher faces extreme circumstances, forcing him to take up arms and lead a fiery rebellion against oppression, becoming an unlikely leader.

metas.name: Mahendragiri Varahi
metas.description: Siddharth, an atheist skeptical of the supernatural, investigates a series of mysterious deaths in Mahendragiri attributed to the goddess Vaaraahi.

metas.name: Together
metas.description: Years into their relationship, Tim and Millie find themselves at a crossroads as they move to the country, abandoning all that is familiar in their lives except each other. With tensions already flaring, a nightmarish encounter with a mysterious, unnatural force threatens to corrupt their lives, their love, and their flesh.

metas.name: The Reluctant Fundamentalist
metas.description: A young Pakistani man chasing corporate success on Wall Street finds himself embroiled in a conflict between his American Dream, a hostage crisis, and the enduring call of his family's homeland.

metas.name: Casper
metas.description: Casper is a kind young ghost who peacefully haunts a mansion in Maine. When specialist James Harvey arrives to communicate with Casper and his fellow spirits, he brings along his teenage daughter, Kat. Casper quickly falls in love with Kat, but their budding relationship is complicated not only by his transparent state, but also by his troublemaking apparition uncles and their mischievous antics.

metas.name: Jahaan Chaar Yaar
metas.description: The journey of four married friends who set off to Goa seeking solace from their ordinary lives and find themselves in - an extraordinary adventure

metas.name: Vishwanath & Sons
metas.description: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

metas.name: Smile
metas.description: After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic incident involving a patient, Dr. Rose Cotter starts experiencing frightening occurrences that she can't explain.

metas.name: Kesari Chapter 2: The Untold Story of Jallianwala Bagh
metas.description: After learning the truth behind the brutal massacre at the Jallianwala Bagh, C Sankaran Nair, a member of the Viceroy's Council, sets out to challenge the Crown and the military general responsible.

metas.name: Shahid
metas.description: A story based on real-life human-rights and criminal lawyer, Shahid Azmi, who was slain while defending the wrongly accused by the law in terrorist activities.

metas.name: Ek Deewane Ki Deewaniyat
metas.description: When Vikramaditya, a powerful politician falls  for a strong-willed superstar Adaa , their passionate romance quickly spirals into a dangerous game of obsession and pride. As emotions clash and tempers rise, Adaa makes a life-altering choice.

metas.name: LSD: Love, Sex Aur Dhokha
metas.description: A video camcorder, a store security camera, and concealed cameras candidly expose lives in three loosely-linked tales.

metas.name: Baby Do Die Do
metas.description: A deaf and mute serial killer in Mumbai can only hear her dead sister's voice as she commits murders for mysterious reasons.

metas.name: The Equalizer 3
metas.description: Robert McCall finds himself at home in Southern Italy but he discovers his friends are under the control of local crime bosses. As events turn deadly, McCall knows what he has to do: become his friends' protector by taking on the mafia.

metas.name: Conan the Barbarian
metas.description: A vengeful barbarian warrior sets off to get his revenge on the evil warlord who attacked his village and murdered his father when he was a boy.

metas.name: Romanchakam
metas.description: An entrepreneur hoping to make money off romance ends up falling in love. But when she blocks him on social media, he tries to reignite their spark.

metas.name: I Saw the TV Glow
metas.description: In late-90s suburbia, a lonely teenager meets a girl at school who introduces him to a mysterious late-night T.V. show — a vision of a supernatural world pulsing beneath their own. As time goes on, however, questions begin to arise about why the show sometimes seems more real than their own lives. In the pale glow of the television, their view of reality begins to crack.

metas.name: Uri: The Surgical Strike
metas.description: Indian army special forces execute a covert operation, avenging the killing of fellow army men at their base by a terrorist group.

metas.name: Deewana
metas.description: Follows a young man experiencing unrequited love as he navigates his longing and vulnerability toward Ammu.

metas.name: The Ballad of Wallis Island
metas.description: An eccentric lottery winner who lives alone on a remote island tries to make his fantasies come true by getting his favourite musicians to perform at his home.

metas.name: The Attacks of 26/11
metas.description: The real story of ten terrorists, who sailed to Mumbai and waged war on the populace for the next 72 hours.

metas.name: Unabomber
metas.description: In this drama inspired by true events, Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy to the infamous Unabomber unfolds as the FBI hunts him down.

metas.name: Pearl
metas.description: Trapped on her family’s isolated farm, Pearl must tend to her ailing father under the bitter and overbearing watch of her devout mother. Lusting for a glamorous life like she’s seen in the movies, Pearl’s ambitions, temptations, and repressions collide.

metas.name: Special Chabbis
metas.description: A gang of con-men rob prominent rich businessmen and politicians by posing as C.B.I and income tax officers.

metas.name: K.G.F: Chapter 2
metas.description: In the blood-soaked Kolar Gold Fields, Rocky's name strikes fear into his foes, while the government sees him as a threat to law and order. Rocky must battle threats from all sides for unchallenged supremacy.

metas.name: Psycho Killer
metas.description: A police officer tracks a killer after her husband, a highway patrolman, becomes one of his victims.

metas.name: Zero
metas.description: Through his relationships with two wildly different women, a vertically challenged bachelor with a larger-than-life persona must discover his purpose.

metas.name: Death of a Unicorn
metas.description: A father and daughter accidentally hit and kill a unicorn while en route to a weekend retreat, where his billionaire boss seeks to exploit the creature’s miraculous curative properties.

metas.name: Backrooms
metas.description: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

metas.name: Pariyerum Perumal
metas.description: A law student from a lower caste begins a friendship with his classmate, a girl who belongs to a higher caste, and the men in her family start giving him trouble over this.

metas.name: Sardar
metas.description: An espionage agent who is branded a traitor returns from exile to take down a dubious water project and safeguard the country.

metas.name: Happy Death Day
metas.description: Caught in a bizarre and terrifying time warp, college student Tree finds herself repeatedly reliving the day of her murder, ultimately realizing that she must identify the killer and the reason for her death before her chances of survival run out.

metas.name: Raazi
metas.description: A Kashmiri woman agrees to marry a Pakistani army officer in order to spy on Pakistan during the Indo-Pakistan War of 1971.

metas.name: The Last Sunrise
metas.description: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.
